journey.name: AC-09, AC-16 - Venda aprovada
journey.description: Pré-requisito: AVD Android 10 com o app e o lio-emulator instalados; app Cielo recém-iniciado (sem pedido abandonado). Execução: skill android-cli (Journeys); lio-emulator 1.61.8 no AVD Android 10.

actions.action: Open the Bilheteria app and verify the screen "Eventos à venda" is shown
Tap the event "Noite de Jazz no Parque"
Verify the screen "Compra" shows the button "Pagar R$ 80,00 no terminal"
Tap the button "Pagar R$ 80,00 no terminal"
In the Cielo emulator, tap "Pagar" and then "Sucesso"
Verify the screen "Comprovante" shows "Pagamento aprovado", the status "Aprovada" and no card number
Press the system Back button and verify the screen "Eventos à venda" is shown, not the purchase screen
Verify the available count of "Noite de Jazz no Parque" decreased by 1
